questions.question: The difference between 44 % of a number and 33% of the same number is 286. What is the 54% of that number?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the number be x

According to question,

⇒ 44% of x – 33% of x = 286

⇒ 0.44x – 0.33x = 286

⇒ 0.11x = 286

⇒ 11x/100 = 286

⇒ x = (286 × 100)/11

⇒ x = 2600

Now,

∴ 54% of x

⇒ 54% of 2600

⇒ (54/100) × 2600 = 1404

**∴ The number is 1404.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

According to the question,

⇒ (44 - 33) = 11 unit → 286 then,

⇒ 1 unit → 286/11 = 26, 

Now, 54 unit → 26 × 54 = 1404

questions.question: Find the number of zeroes in 129!
questions.solution:
**Given:**

129!

**Concept Used:**

No. of zeroes = Sum of all quotient

**Calculation:**

As, 5 × 2 will give a zero and nearest multiple of of 5 below 129 is 125

Number of multiples of 5 in 129! = 125/5

⇒ 25

Number of multiples of 5² ie 25 in 129! = 125/25

⇒ 5

Number of multiple of 5³ ie 125 in 129! = 125/125

⇒ 1

Total zero = 25 + 5 + 1

⇒ 31

**∴ Total number of zero is 31.**

questions.question: In a bucket, paint and oil are in the ratio 7 : 5. 24 litres of mixture is drawn off and 24 litres of oil is added. If the ratio of paint and oil becomes 1 : 1, then how many litres of paint was contained in the bucket initially?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let initial quantity of paint and oil be 7x and 5x

⇒ Total quantity = 7x + 5x = 12x

Now 24 litres is removed and 24 litres oil is added

⇒ Quantity of paint left = 7x – {24 × (7x/12x)} = 7x – 14

⇒ Quantity of oil = 5x – {24 × (5x/12x)} + 24 = 5x – 10 + 24 = 5x + 14

According to question,

⇒ (7x – 14) / (5x + 14) = 1/1

⇒ 7x – 14 = 5x + 14

⇒ 2x = 28

⇒ x = 14

**∴ initial quantity of paint = 7x = 7 × 14 = 98 litres**

questions.question: The average age of Sita and Gita is 30 years. If Rita replaces Sita, then the average age will become 28 years and if Rita replaces Gita, then the average age will become 32 years. What are the respective ages (in years) of Sita, Gita and Rita?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum of age of Sita and Geeta = average × 2 = 30 × 2

⇒ S + G = 60 ----(1)

⇒ Sum of age of Geeta and Rita = average × 2 = 28 × 2

⇒ G + R = 56 ----(2)

⇒ Sum of age of Sita and rita = average × 2 = 32 × 2

⇒ S + R = 64 ----(3)

 Now, subtracting (2) from (1) we get

⇒ S – R = 4 ----(4)

Now, adding (3) and (4) we get,

⇒ 2S = 68

⇒ S = 34

Now,

⇒ R = 64 – S = 64 – 34 = 30

⇒ G = 56 – R = 56 – 30 = 26

**∴ age of Sita, Gita and Rita is 34, 26 and .30 respectively**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 800 becomes Rs. 1000 in 2 years at simple interest. What is the per annum rate of interest (in percent)?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

• Simple interest = (principal × time × rate)/100

• Amount = sum + simple interest

**Calculation:**

Let rate be r%

Simple interest = (800 × 2 × r)/100 = 16r

We know, amount = sum + simple interest

According to the question,

⇒ 1000 = 800 + 16r

⇒ 16r = 200

**∴ r = 12.5%**

questions.question: D sells a table to E at a proﬁt of 30% and E sells it to F at a loss of 30%. What is the ratio of cost prices of D and F?
questions.solution:
Calculation: 

Let Cost price of D be Rs. 100

⇒ Cost price of E = selling price of D = 100 + 30% of 100 = Rs. 130

⇒ Cost price of F = selling price of E = 130 – 30% of 130 = Rs. 91

**∴ Required ratio = 100 ∶ 91**

questions.question: The marked price of a calculator is Rs. 750. It is sold at a discount of 22%. If the cost price of the calculator is Rs. 500, then what is the proﬁt (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = Rs. 750

**Concept used:**

Selling price = marked price – discount% on the marked price

**Calculation:**

⇒ 750 – 22% of 750 = Rs. 585

Cost price = Rs. 500

**∴ Profit = Selling price – cost price = 585 – 500 = Rs. 85**

P, Q and R alone can complete a work in 12, 15 and 20 days respectively. In how many days will they together complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

• Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Efficiency of P = 1/12

Efficiency of Q = 1/15

Efficiency of R = 1/20

Efficiency of P, Q and R together = (1/12) + (1/15) + (1/20) = (5 + 4 + 3)/60 = 12/60 = 1/5

**∴ They will take 5 days to complete the work**

questions.question: The distance between two cities X and Y is 270 km. First train starts from X at 7:00 a.m. and travels towards Y at 40 km/hr. Second train starts from Y at 8:30 a.m. and travels towards X at 30 km/hr. At what time (in a.m.) will both the trains meet?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

• Time taken = distance/speed

**Calculation:**

Total distance travelled by first train in 1 and half hour (from 7:00 am to 8:30 am) = speed × time = 40 × {1 + (1/2)} = 40 × (3/2) = 60 km

Total distance to be covered now = 270 – 60 = 210 km

Relative speed = 40 + 30 = 70 km/hr

Time taken = distance/speed = 210/70 = 3 hr

**∴ They will meet at 11:30 am ie. (8:30 am + 3 hrs)**

questions.question: The perimeter and the breadth of a rectangle are 46 cm and 8 cm respectively. Calculate the length of its diagonal (in cm)
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

• Perimeter = 2(length + breadth)

• Diagonal = √(length2 + breadth2) 

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ 46 = 2(length + 8)

⇒ Length = 23 – 8 = 15 cm

Also, every angle of rectangle is 90°

**∴ Diagonal = √(length² + breadth²) = √{(15)² + (8)² = √289 = 17 cm**

questions.question: Calculate the area (in cm²) of a circle whose diameter is 7 cm.
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

• Radius = diameter/2

• Area = π × radius2 

**Calculation:**

Radius = diameter/2 = 7/2 cm

Area = (22/7) × (7/2)² = 38.5 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 38.5 cm2**

questions.question: Find the surface area (in cm²) of a sphere of diameter 28 cm.
questions.solution:

• Radius = diameter/2

• Surface area of a sphere = 4 × π × radius2

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Radius = 28/2 = 14 cm

**∴ Surface area = 4 × (22/7) × 14² = 2464 cm²**

questions.question: ΔXYZ is right angled at Y. If sinX = 12/13, then what is the value of cosecZ ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

ΔXYZ is right-angled at Y and sinX = 12/13

**Concept used:**

• Hypotenuse² = Perpendicular² + Base² 

• sin θ = Perpendicular/Hypotenuse = 1/cosec θ 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c45a77a23
5a6e63fa5efbaaa994d1378d758de67a3af83d5cbf8484b3c6023ad.png] 

sinX = 12/13

⇒ YZ/XZ = 12/13

Let YZ = 12k and XZ = 13k

By Pythagoras theorem,

⇒ XY = √(XZ² – YZ²) = √{(13k)² – (12k)²} = √(25k²) = 5k

Now,

**∴ cosec Z = XZ/XY = 13k/5k = 13/5**
